coverage.name: API transactions, isolation, restart persistence and backup recovery
anonymous saves are isolated and credential stays in HttpOnly cookie
concurrent duplicate training bills once and stale writes reject
invalid action rolls back and cross-origin requests reject
competing transfers only sign once
durable match freezes writes, survives restart, and leaves HTTP responsive
duplicate match requests settle once and replay payloads are private and separate
full season persists through process restart
live database backup restores into a fresh data directory
mental caps, leader and resilience limits, fatigue monotonicity and trait zero effects
adaptation migrates additively, advances only with calendar and is nationality independent
offside is frozen at touch, mirrors correctly, includes keeper and waits for involvement
foul severity, penalty DOGSO, two yellows and direct red are distinct
physical shootouts preserve ordinary score/stats, deterministic replay and cosmetic invariance
module claims exclude other developers/worktrees and stale writes cannot overwrite newer code
seeded engine reproduces complete event log and keeps score consistent
round robin has balanced fixtures and no repeated club per round
invalid, foreign and duplicate lineups rejected
training is bounded per round and finance never allows overspending
a complete season balances standings, pays one award, and can continue
cup cannot be replayed after elimination or completed final
signing removes exactly one market player and bills once
finite first touches control at least 95 of 100 unopposed medium-quality 10m passes
controller survives a brief independent carry but never gives remote contact
durable slices, including halftime, restore exactly the same events, stats and binary frames
fixture order has frozen independent inputs and settlement rejects partial rounds
a new task waits until the previous worker has fully retired
completed replay is one gzip member with every live chunk in order
a transaction that cannot begin does not roll back a nonexistent transaction or lose its checkpoint
an unreadable checkpoint isolates the failed task and preserves its original bytes
task admission freezes input, joins two modes, bounds queue and resumes the same failed request
a failed final transaction preserves the previous checkpoint, money, operation and replay tables
long historical reports are losslessly stored outside state, while legacy reports stay unchanged
worker continuation and a new worker restored from transferred frames equal uninterrupted simulation
domain modules have owners, documented boundaries, public imports and no dependency cycles
each client feature has one module owner and local handover records
actual rigid-body sprint, acceleration and fatigue respond to player attributes within human bounds
turning brakes over time and capsule impacts cannot launch a superhuman runner
grass rolling slows progressively to rest without skidding to walking speed or reversing
flying balls lose substantial aerodynamic speed and turf bounce dissipates energy
planned 5, 10 and 30 metre ground passes arrive at a useful speed and predicted time
kicks remain contact-limited and bounded; lofted planning accounts for flight drag
gravity, grass bounce, inertia and body/goalpost collisions use rigid-body physics
a kick requires an overlapping foot, and the ball stays independent afterwards
only a whole-ball swept crossing between posts and under the crossbar scores
scored ball continues into the net before a delayed kickoff resets positions
player attributes and fatigue determine locomotion; tactics change saved team movement
ground passes keep useful speed in either direction without colliding with the kicker trunk
a freshly reoriented finite foot uses current geometry, without waiting for stale sensor pairs
jogging, pressing, sprinting and controlled carrying use distinct physical speeds
an organiser passes and a dribbler carries in the same open situation across common seeds
a blocked passing corridor is rejected and a forward with a clear chance chooses a shot
supporters form triangles, a loose ball is recovered, and a keeper approaches a slow ball
a physical segment has fast passes, mostly submaximal running, and meaningful player behaviour statistics
player identities and thirty bounded abilities are seeded and individually varied
birthdays follow the game calendar, including season transitions and market players
training uses age and professionalism, trains keepers separately, and never lowers capped skills
personality persists while training and match settlement update appropriate fields
schema 1 upgrade preserves gameplay, money, ages, identity and immutable historical replays
database migration is atomic and unsupported schemas stop startup without partial changes

notes: All baseline scenario names remain; moved physical/decision/checkpoint/shootout/worker bodies retain their assertions.
API parent is parameterized: business, controlled season and real match wrappers select the original scenarios.
API fixed engine string follows ENGINE_VERSION; season assertions still require round 14 in the season mode and ordinary backup assertions require round 2.
Birthday/cup tests prepare explicit boundary state; the full season assertions remain in tests/season.
A scenario inventory is evidence of migration, not evidence that the real physics tier ran in this workflow-only change.
